title: Room and Smile
author: Isandro Dravenmoor
blurb: Ada Nystrom, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
